ashwin: quick sanity check — rotating REDWOOD_API_KEY for staging and after rotate a couple services returned 401s, but only the streaming endpoints. anyone seen this pattern?

maria: yup. classic trailing-newline / copy-paste BOM issue. streaming clients tend to be stricter about exact header bytes.

ashwin: repro notes: with curl it worked: `curl -H "Authorization: Basic $(echo -n $KEY | base64)" ...` but our node streaming client (fetch/websocket) got 401. i tried `echo $KEY | base64` vs `echo -n $KEY | base64` and behavior changed.

sam: node `fetch` doesn't magically add CRLF to headers — more likely the way the key gets read from the env or pipeline introduces `
`/``. also different base64 implementations can add line breaks.

maria: short checklist i use: 1) ensure you don't `echo` without `-n`; 2) prefer `Buffer.from(KEY).toString('base64')` in node; 3) trim the env when loading (and remove BOM). example: 
```js
const key = process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY?.trim().replace(/^\uFEFF/, '');
const header = `Basic ${Buffer.from(key).toString('base64')}`;
```
this fixed streaming issues for me.

ashwin: tried adding `.trim()` and `replace` — that fixed our streaming client. strange that curl (from shell) worked earlier; i guess my local shell had no trailing CRLF but k8s secret did.

jen: another useful check: decode the secret from k8s and visualize whitespace markers: `kubectl get secret staging-api -o jsonpath='{.data.API_KEY}' | base64 --decode | sed -n l` — `sed -n l` will show `` as `^M` etc. also check for BOM with `xxd` or `hexdump -C`.

ashwin: confirmed — k8s secret had trailing ``. rotated keys and updated secret with `printf %s "$KEY" | base64` to avoid newline. canary looks healthy now. leaving a note to add to SDK readme.

sam: follow-up nits: 1) unit test the header generation in the SDK (cover trim + BOM removal), 2) add a tiny troubleshooting section to devex docs: ¬"why 401 on streaming but not normal requests" with the `sed -n l` example.

ashwin: @sam can you pick up the unit test? i'll PR the README snippet and add the k8s decode command.

devops-bot: Scheduled key rotation reminder: staging rotation planned 2026-03-18 02:00 UTC. I'll create the secret-update PR. :robot_face:

ashwin: thanks all — filing a tiny task in backlog and will mark as done once sam's test lands.
